Guideline ranges from the Institute of Medicine. Discuss your personal target with your healthcare provider. For information only — not medical advice.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your height and pre-pregnancy weight to get your BMI and IOM recommended gain range.
  2. Log weigh-ins with date and weight.
  3. See each entry's total gain and whether it is inside the recommended range.
  4. View the chart of your gain against the guideline band.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What are the IOM ranges?

Underweight (BMI <18.5): 12.5-18 kg; normal (18.5-24.9): 11.5-16 kg; overweight (25-29.9): 7-11.5 kg; obese (30+): 5-9 kg total gain.

Where is my log stored?

In your browser's localStorage. Nothing is uploaded.

Is this medical advice?

No. These are general guidelines; your provider may set a different target for you.
